```{r parameters}
year_to_load <- "2018"

path_to_intermediate <- "data-cleaning/intermediate_claims/"

to_read <- FALSE
to_sample <- TRUE
to_use_intermediate <- TRUE
to_chunk <- FALSE
to_write <- TRUE
to_group <- FALSE

sample_size <- 25000
chunk_size <- 1000000
na_values <- c('NONE','None','-','--','---','N/A','n/a','nan','NAN') 
na_like_strings <- c("", " ", "  ", "-", "none", "None", "NONE", "NA", "n/a", 
                     "N/A", "NaN", "'", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v", "\u00A0", 
                     "\u2000", "\u2001", "\u2002", "\u2003", "\u2004", "\u2005",
                     "\u2006", "\u2007", "\u2008", "\u2009", "\u200A", "\u2028",
                     "\u2029", "\u202F", "\u205F", "\u3000")
drop_cols <- 76:196 # Columns to drop (based on indexes)
```

```{r read and sample data}
if (to_read){
  # Read the entire file into memory
  tic("Reading entire data file")
  df <- fread(here(paste0(path_to_raw_claims, "claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv")),
              na.strings = na_values)
  toc()
}

# If to_sample is TRUE, sample the data
if (to_sample) {
  if (file.exists(here(paste0("drg-cleaning/raw_claims", "sampled_claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv"))) & !to_read){
    df <- fread(here(paste0(path_to_raw_claims, "sampled_claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv")),
            na.strings = na_values)
  } else
  set.seed(123)  # Set seed for reproducibility
  df <- df[sample(.N, min(sample_size, .N))]
}

if (to_write) {
  fwrite(df, here(paste0(path_to_raw_claims, "sampled_claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv")))
}
```

```{r identify droppable columns}
chunk_number <- 1

header <- names(df)
total_rows <- nrow(df)

tic("Processing header row")
# Get the columns to keep by excluding the drop columns
cols_to_keep <- setdiff(seq_along(header), drop_cols)
toc()

tic("Identifying droppable columns")
# Check which columns can be dropped
droppable_cols <- sapply(df, function(col) all(is.na(col) | col %in% na_like_strings))
droppable_cols <- which(droppable_cols)
chunk_droppable_cols[[paste0(year_to_load, "_whole")]] <- droppable_cols
toc()

saveRDS(chunk_droppable_cols, chunk_droppable_cols_file)
saveRDS(header, header_file)
saveRDS(total_rows, total_rows_file)
```

```{r step 2}
# Step 2: Find columns that are droppable in all chunks
all_chunks_droppable_cols <- Reduce(intersect, chunk_droppable_cols)

# Step 3: Process the data and save if required

tic("Processing data")
df <- df[, ..cols_to_keep]

# Add a column id_year and set its value to the variable year_to_load
df[, SRC_YR := as.integer(year_to_load)]

# Update columns as per your processing steps
df[, PATIENT_TYPE := fcase(

)]

df[, MEMCAT_PARENT_DESC := fcase(

)]

df[, MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC := fcase(

  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SELF-EARNING INDIVIDUAL", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SENIOR CITIZEN", "SENIOR",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "INDIGENT", "INDIGENT",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "LIFETIME MEMBER", "LIFETIME",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SPONSORED", "SPONSORED",

  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "EMPLOYED GOVERNMENT", "FORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "INFORMAL ECONOMY", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "HOUSEHOLD HELP/KASAMBAHAY", "FORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "FOREIGN NATIONAL", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "FILIPINOS WITH DUAL CITIZENSHIP / LIVING ABROAD", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SELF EARNING INDIVIDUAL", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "FAMILY DRIVER", "FORMAL"
)]

df[, DISPOSITION := fcase(
  DISPOSITION == "IMPROVED", 1L,
  DISPOSITION == "RECOVERED", 1L,
  DISPOSITION == "HOME/DISCHARGED AGAINST MEDICAL ADVICE", 2L,
  DISPOSITION == "ABSCONDED", 3L,
  DISPOSITION == "TRANSFERRED/REFERRED", 4L,
  DISPOSITION == "EXPIRED", 9L,
  DISPOSITION == "UNDEFINED", NA_integer_
)]

# Redefine icd_cols and rvs_cols based on remaining columns
icd_cols <- intersect(colnames(df), c(paste0("ICDCODE", c(1:14, 16:170)), "ICCODED15"))
rvs_cols <- intersect(colnames(df), paste0("RVSCODE", 1:20))

# Process and collapse ICD and RVS columns
process_and_collapse_columns <- function(df, cols_to_process, new_col_name) {
  for (col in cols_to_process) {
    set(df, j = col, value = iconv(df[[col]], to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte"))
    set(df, j = col, value = toupper(df[[col]]))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_trim(df[[col]]))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_replace_all(df[[col]], " ", ""))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_replace_all(df[[col]], "\n", ""))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_replace_all(df[[col]], "[^\\w\\d\\/\\s]+", ""))
    set(df, j = col, value = ifelse(df[[col]] %in% na_like_strings, NA_character_, df[[col]]))
  }

  df[, (new_col_name) := do.call(paste, c(.SD, sep = "||")), .SDcols = cols_to_process]
  df[, (new_col_name) := str_replace_all(get(new_col_name), "\\|\\|NA", "")]
  df[, (new_col_name) := str_replace_all(get(new_col_name), "NA\\|\\|", "")]
  df[, (new_col_name) := str_replace_all(get(new_col_name), "\\|\\|$", "")]
  df[, (new_col_name) := ifelse(get(new_col_name) == "NA", NA_character_, get(new_col_name))]

  df[, (cols_to_process) := NULL]
}
toc()

tic("Processing ICD columns")
process_and_collapse_columns(df, icd_cols, "ICD_CODES")
toc()
tic("Processing RVS columns")
process_and_collapse_columns(df, rvs_cols, "RVS_CODES")
toc()

if (to_write) {
  tic("Writing processed data")
  # Save the processed data
  fwrite(df, here(paste0(path_to_intermediate, "intermediate_claims_", year_to_load, "_processed.csv")))
  toc()
}
```

```{r merge intermediate files and export}
if (to_write) {
  # Directory and file paths
  intermediate_dir <- here(path_to_intermediate)
  output_file <- here("data-cleaning/cleaned_claims", 
                      paste0("cleaned_claims_extract_CLAIMS_", 
                             year_to_load, ".csv"))

  # Get the list of intermediate files
  intermediate_files <- list.files(intermediate_dir, 
                                   pattern = paste0("intermediate_claims_", 
                                                    year_to_load, 
                                                    "_processed\\.csv$"), 
                                   full.names = TRUE)

  # Function to read a file
  read_file <- function(file) {
    fread(file, na.strings = na_values)
  }

  # Read files sequentially
  tic("Reading and merging intermediate files")
  all_chunks <- lapply(intermediate_files, read_file)
  toc()

  # Combine all chunks into one data.table
  merged_data <- rbindlist(all_chunks)

  # Export the combined data to a CSV file
  tic("Writing merged data to CSV")
  fwrite(merged_data, output_file)
  toc()
}
```

```{r find lumped codes}
# Use the cleaned data
sampled_dt_cleaned <- df

# Function to find lumped together codes based on the criteria:
# - String length > 4
# - Contains more than one letter
# - Contains more than one digit
find_lumped_codes <- function(codes) {
  sapply(codes, function(code) {
    nchar(code) > 4 &&
    sum(str_detect(strsplit(code, NULL)[[1]], "[A-Za-z]")) > 1 &&
    sum(str_detect(strsplit(code, NULL)[[1]], "[0-9]")) > 1
  })
}

# Identify ICD codes in clin_icd
icds <- unique(unlist(strsplit(sampled_dt_cleaned$clin_icd, "||", fixed = TRUE)))

# Debug: Print the first few ICD codes
cat("First few ICD codes:\n")
print(head(icds))

# Debug: Print the number of ICD codes
cat("Total number of ICD codes:\n")
print(length(icds))

# Find lumped ICD codes based on the criteria
to_delist <- icds[find_lumped_codes(icds)]

# Debug: Print the codes to be delisted
cat("ICD codes to be delisted:\n")
print(to_delist)

# Create a mask for rows with lumped ICD codes, only if to_delist is not empty
if (length(to_delist) > 0) {
  delist_pattern <- paste(to_delist, collapse = "|")
  delist_mask <- str_detect(sampled_dt_cleaned$clin_icd, delist_pattern)
} else {
  delist_mask <- rep(FALSE, nrow(sampled_dt_cleaned))
}

# Debug: Print the number of rows with lumped ICD codes
cat("Number of rows with lumped ICD codes:\n")
print(sum(delist_mask))

# Update clin_icd column to remove lumped codes
sampled_dt_cleaned[delist_mask, clin_icd := str_replace_all(clin_icd, delist_pattern, "")]
```

```{r output for batch grouper}
if (to_group) {
  output_txt_file <- here(paste0(path_to_cleaned_claims,
                                 "DRG_Grouped_Sample_", year_to_load, ".txt"))
  # Function to generate DOB from age and admission date
  generate_dob_vectorized <- function(bdays, ages, date_adms) {
    dob <- rep(NA_character_, length(ages))  # Initialize dob vector
    dob[!is.na(bdays) & bdays != ""] <- format(mdy(bdays[!is.na(bdays) & bdays != ""]), "%d/%m/%Y")  
        # Use PAT_BDAY where available

    # Indices where PAT_BDAY is not available
    missing_bday_indices <- which(is.na(bdays) | bdays == "")

    # Use age and date_adm to generate DOB for those with missing PAT_BDAY
    ref_dates <- mdy(date_adms[missing_bday_indices])
    
    # Case 1: age == 0
    zero_age_indices <- which(!is.na(ages[missing_bday_indices]) & 
                                ages[missing_bday_indices] == 0)
    dob[missing_bday_indices[zero_age_indices]] <- format(ref_dates[zero_age_indices] - days(sample(1:27, length(zero_age_indices), replace = TRUE)), "%d/%m/%Y")
    
    # Case 2: age > 0
    positive_age_indices <- which(!is.na(ages[missing_bday_indices]) & ages[missing_bday_indices] > 0)
    truncated_ages <- floor(ages[missing_bday_indices][positive_age_indices])
    dob[missing_bday_indices[positive_age_indices]] <- format(ref_dates[positive_age_indices] - years(truncated_ages) - days(sample(1:170, length(positive_age_indices), replace = TRUE)), "%d/%m/%Y")
    
    return(dob)
  }

  # Prepare the data for the text file
  df <- data.table(CASEID = 1:nrow(sampled_dt_cleaned))
  df[, DOB := generate_dob_vectorized(sampled_dt_cleaned$PAT_BDAY, sampled_dt_cleaned$PATAGE, sampled_dt_cleaned$DATE_ADM)]
  df[, Sex := ifelse(sampled_dt_cleaned$PATSEX == "M", 1, 2)]
  df[, DateAdm := format(mdy(sampled_dt_cleaned$DATE_ADM), "%d/%m/%Y")]
  df[, TimeAdm := gsub(":", "", sampled_dt_cleaned$TIME_ADM)]
  df[, DateDsc := format(mdy(sampled_dt_cleaned$DATE_DIS), "%d/%m/%Y")]
  df[, TimeDsc := gsub(":", "", sampled_dt_cleaned$TIME_DIS)]
  df[, DischT := sampled_dt_cleaned$DISPOSITION]
  df[, AdmWt := sampled_dt_cleaned$PAT_BWT_KG]
  df[, PDx := sampled_dt_cleaned$PRIMARY_ILLNESS]

  # Split ICD_CODES into multiple columns, ensuring 12 elements per row
  split_icd_codes <- function(icd_str) {
    codes <- unlist(strsplit(icd_str, "||", fixed = TRUE))
    length(codes) <- 12  # Ensuring 12 elements, with NA for missing
    codes
  }

  icd_codes_list <- lapply(sampled_dt_cleaned$clin_icd, split_icd_codes)
  icd_codes <- do.call(rbind, icd_codes_list)
  icd_cols <- paste0("SDx", 1:12)
  df[, (icd_cols) := as.data.table(icd_codes)]

  # Split RVS_CODES into multiple columns, ensuring 20 elements per row
  split_rvs_codes <- function(rvs_str) {
    codes <- unlist(strsplit(rvs_str, "||", fixed = TRUE))
    length(codes) <- 20  # Ensuring 20 elements, with NA for missing
    codes
  }

  rvs_codes_list <- lapply(sampled_dt_cleaned$clin_rvs, split_rvs_codes)
  rvs_codes <- do.call(rbind, rvs_codes_list)
  proc_cols <- paste0("Proc", 1:20)
  df[, (proc_cols) := as.data.table(rvs_codes)]

  # Replace NA values with '--'
  df[is.na(df)] <- '--'

  # Write the data to a text file
  fwrite(df, output_txt_file, sep = "|", col.names = TRUE)
}
```
